title: a bug hunt of the product's own source, batch 1 (lane X, 2026-11-22)

findings.claim: the lake has no route gate: the criteria compiler's service token can promote a built night and release a job's hold (POST /promote, DELETE /holds/{holder})
FHIR Bulk pseudonymisation keeps every resource's narrative text and a Reference's display and identifier, so patients' names and chart numbers reach the lake
FHIR Bulk pseudonymisation misses absolute and versioned references: the record does not link to its patient's pseudonym (an absolute one keeps the chart number)
a FHIR R4 partial birth date (1960, 1960-05) fails the whole night's lake build in Flattener.ts; worse than H34-10, which is an invalid date
the key-service client follows redirects and resends its token header to any Location, plain http included (libs/tb_common/kek.py _kms_call)
a chart-number pattern with an anchor on each branch masks neither format mid-line in the log scrubber, the PHI scan or the guard (strip of outer anchors only); lane F's area
the feasibility mail's HTML part passes a criterion label's inline HTML through as live markup (mail_gateway render_body)
the document parser inflates an uploaded DOCX with no member, total or ratio cap, so an upload under 50 MB can exhaust its memory; owner not determined
audit verify raises TypeError or AttributeError on a line that is JSON but not an object, instead of naming the line; lane F's area
the egress check that only the gateway reaches a model host compares the host exactly, so an upper-case or trailing-dot spelling in EGRESS_EXTRA passes
the NHI host opens an orchestrator egress rule without the model-host check the REDCap host gets
a study-scoped console account refused at GET /audit reads every study's audit list through POST /audit/verify; the scope check matches /audit exactly (D-380)
POST /lang checks its way back with its own rule, not local_path, though D-1156 says the one rule covers it; no off-site redirect today
